description: Task heading parity between the Rust indexer (extract_tasks_and_headings in src-tauri/src/vault/parsing.rs, through NoteEntry::from_content) and the e2e mock parser (parseTasks in e2e/mocks/vault-index.ts).

Each case gives a note's content and the expected wire fields: taskHeadings (omitted when empty) and each task's text, lineNumber and heading (omitted before the first heading). Both sides assert these exact values.

cases.name: frontmatter comment and fenced lines are not headings
cases.content:
---
title: x
# comment
---
## A #to-list
- [ ] a task
### B
- [ ] b task
```
# not a heading
- [ ] fenced
```
## C
- [ ] c task

cases.name: a task before the first heading has no heading
a note without tasks records no headings
headings with no task under them stay listed
a tilde fence closes only on a tilde fence
